name: LightCraft
tagline: Your photos. Your pixels. Your machine.
blurb: A fast photo library and non-destructive raw developer, written from scratch in pure Rust. No account, no cloud, no telemetry.
description:
LightCraft delivers a lightning-fast catalog and non-destructive RAW processing engine.

Includes exposure, highlights, shadows, curves, HSL color grading, sharpening, noise reduction, and lens profile corrections on your local library.

install.label: Cargo / Build from source
install.command: git clone https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft.git && cd lightcraft && cargo run --release
